lines.say: A hundred thousand people opened your app at once.
lines.show: *100,000 people* opened your app at once.

lines.say: It didn't even slow down. How?
One server would struggle with that. So you run ten copies of your app on ten servers.
lines.show: One server would [struggle] with that. So you run *10 copies* of your app on *10 servers.*

lines.say: But who decides which server gets each request, like each page load? A load balancer.
lines.show: But who decides which server gets each request, like each page load? A [load balancer.]

lines.say: Like a supermarket manager pointing you to the shortest checkout line.
lines.show: Like a *supermarket manager* pointing you to the [shortest checkout line.]

lines.say: The simplest rule is round robin: one, two, three, then back to one.
lines.show: The simplest rule is [round robin:] 1, 2, 3, then back to 1.

lines.say: A smarter one, least connections, picks the server with the fewest open connections.
lines.show: A smarter one, [least connections,] picks the server with the *fewest open connections.*

lines.say: It also pings every server every few seconds. If one stops answering, it gets skipped.
lines.show: It also *pings every server* every few seconds. If one stops answering, it [gets skipped.]

lines.say: Need more power? Add servers behind it. Users keep using the same address.
lines.show: Need more power? *Add servers* behind it. Users keep using [the same address.]

lines.say: AWS, NGINX and Cloudflare all do this.
